// diagnostic

E0381

A marker declaration used a retired trailing `on` clause or second parameter list.

What

A marker declaration used a retired trailing `on` clause or second parameter list.

Why

D-MARKER-SITES1=B gives every marker one named parameter list: ordinary names have types, and `@` names have fixed metadata values.

Fix

Write `marker Name(args..., @sites: [...], @repeatable: true, ...)`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0381: tests/ui/marker_decl_rejected_forms.stderr.

Error [E0381]: a trailing `on` clause isn't how a marker states a fact
  --> tests/ui/marker_decl_rejected_forms.jet:6:29
    |
  6 | marker Inline(mode: String) on [.Function]
    |                             ^^
 Why: D-MARKER-SITES1=B: every marker declaration uses one named parameter list; ordinary arguments are typed parameters and `@` names are fixed metadata values — not a clause after the list
 Fix: move the sites into the parameter list as `@sites: [.Function, …]`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0381

Error [E0381]: a second parameter list isn't how a marker states a fact
  --> tests/ui/marker_decl_rejected_forms.jet:8:30
    |
  8 | marker Pre(condition: String)(sites: [.Function])
    |                              ^
 Why: D-MARKER-SITES1=B: the rule's own typed arguments and fixed metadata share one named-parameter list, told apart by the compile-time `@` sigil — not two parameter lists
 Fix: fold the second list's facts into the first as `@sites: […]`, `@repeatable: true`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0381

Error [E0381]: the checked-text marker declaration is retired
  --> tests/ui/marker_decl_rejected_forms.jet:10:17
    |
 10 | marker Selector on [.Text] {
    |                 ^^
 Why: D-MARKER-SITES1=B: every marker declaration uses one named parameter list; `@sites` records legal sites, and checked-text contracts are not a separate marker form
 Fix: write `marker Selector(@sites: [.Text])` for a plain rule, or use a built-in typed text head
